requirements.summary: AMS1117 (U1) pinout matches its datasheet (1=GND/ADJ, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN). ESP-12F supply, GND, EN, RST, UART and strap pins go to sensible nets, but the local docs cover the ESP8266EX/ESP-WROOM-02 and not the ESP-12F itself. K1 is ordered as an Omron G5RL-1A-E-HR, yet it sits on a G2RL-1A-E symbol and footprint. The G5RL datasheet text could not be extracted, so the relay pinout and the SS8050 and HLK-PM01 pinouts could not be confirmed.

GPIO15 is pulled down by R5 to GND. GPIO2 (R4) and GPIO0 (R3) are pulled up to +3V3. EN has a pull-up (R1) plus C7, and RST has a pull-up (R2) plus C8. These are the flash-boot levels the Espressif pin table requires.

C1, the 470 uF electrolytic bulk capacitor rated 4 V, is connected straight across the +5 V rail (PS1 +Vout). That is a continuous over-voltage, so the part will degrade or fail, possibly by venting. U1 VIN at 5 V is well below the AMS1117's 15 V absolute maximum.

evidence.quote: C1 (470uF 4V) exceeds voltage derating on +5V (5.0V on 4V electrolytic cap) (heuristic)

requirements.summary: Mains input has a T500mA fuse (F1) before the HLK-PM01, and the varistor RV1 sits after the fuse across L_F and N, which is the right placement. RV1 is a 07D221K, a 220 V varistor-voltage part, normally rated for about 140 VAC continuous. No intent document gives the mains voltage; the Spanish naming ('rele') suggests 230 VAC, where this MOV would conduct continuously and fail. The relay load path (L_IN to K1 to L_OUT) has no fuse of its own. Assumption: 230 VAC mains.

C1's 4 V rating is below the 5 V rail it sits on, so the value does not fit its function. The other values are reasonable: 10k pull-ups and pull-down, a 1k/10k base divider on Q1, a 220 R LED resistor and 1N4148W flyback diode D1 with K to +5V and A to COIL_N.

Footprints could not be fully checked against the ordered MPNs, and no approved-footprint list exists. K1 is ordered as a G5RL-1A-E-HR (LCSC C113250) but uses the G2RL-1A-E footprint, and the G5RL datasheet text was unreadable. C1's D6.3 mm can footprint must match the actual size of LCSC C112505, which may change once the rating is raised. J3 uses a single-row 01x06 symbol on a 2x03 header footprint, so the pin mapping should be confirmed.

evidence.quote: no approved-footprint list; 17 footprints awaiting approval

extra_findings.text: error: C1 (4 V electrolytic) sits directly across the 5 V output of the HLK-PM01. Replace it with a part rated 10 V or more (16 V preferred) and re-check the footprint diameter.
warning: RV1 is a 07D221K (220 V varistor voltage), which suits about 120 VAC mains. On 230 VAC it is undersized and will overheat or fail. Use a 07D471K or 10D471K for 230 VAC.
warning: The relay load circuit L_IN to L_OUT has no overcurrent protection on the board. F1 only protects the PS1 branch. [unverified]
